title: Yhteisöllisen asuminen, kevyt ja tuetun asumisen palvelut, osa-alue 3: Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva / 1. uudelleen avaus
description: Yhteisöllisen asuminen, kevyt ja tuetun asumisen palvelut, osa-alue 3: Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva / 1. uudelleen avaus Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Yhteisöllisen asumisen, kevyen ja tuetun asumisen palvelujen hankintamenettelyn 2489/2024 ensimmäiseen uudelleen avaukseen. Uudelleen avaus koskee osa-aluetta 3 Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki tarkoittaa henkilöstön läsnäoloa vuoden jokaisena päivänä palvelukuvauksessa määritellyllä tavalla. Päihteet sallivassa yksikössä päihteiden käyttöä ei varsinaisesti rajoiteta, mutta sen tuottamia haittoja ehkäistään ja vähennetään. Tarvittaessa yksikön henkilökunnan tulee tukea asiakasta kohti päihteettömyyttä. Hankittava palvelu on kuvattu tarkemmin palvelukuvauksessa. Uudelleen avaus koskee hankintamenettelyn osa-aluetta 3. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Uudelleen avauksen osalta hankinnan arvioitu arvonlisäveroton arvo on noin 2 000 000 euroa vuodessa. Arvio on suuntaa-antava eikä sido tilaajaa. Uudelleen avauksessa valitaan halvimman hinnan perusteella kolme (3) uutta yksikköä tuottamaan palvelua. Tilaajan tarve yksiköille painottuu Tampereen alueelle. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valitut kaksi (2) yksikköä jatkavat palvelua perustamisvaiheen hankintasopimusten mukaisesti ja niiden osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan. Kyseisten perustamisvaiheessa valittujen yksiköiden osalta palveluntuottajat voivat kuitenkin jättää tässä uudelleen avauksessa tarjouksen laskeakseen voimassa olevaa hintaa. Palveluntuottajarekisteri päivitetään uusien tarjousten perusteella. Palveluntuottajat luetellaan rekisterissä uuden vertailun mukaisessa sijajärjestyksessä. Hankintamenettelyn avaamisen ja uusien tarjousten myötä myös aiemmin valitun palveluntuottajan vertailun mukainen sijajärjestys saattaa muuttua uuden vertailun perusteella. Hankintamenettelyn uudelleen avauksen yhteydessä hyväksyttyjen palveluntuottajien sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027. Sopimuskausi on voimassa toistaiseksi. Palveluntuottajien on aloitettava palvelutuotanto viimeistään 1.9.2027. Sopimuksen voi irtisanoa hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ilmoitetuin irtisanomisehdoin. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valittujen palveluntuottajien osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan, eikä sopimuskauden pituuteen tule muutoksia tämän uudelleen avauksen myötä. Mahdolliset hinnanmuutokset päivitetään palveluntuottajarekisteriin. Tarjousten valinta- ja vertailuperusteet ovat tarkemmin kuvattuna tarjouspyynnön "Päätöksenteon perusteet"-kohdassa.,

title: VCF (VMware Cloud Foundation)-palvelu ja toimittajan tukipalvelut
description: VCF (VMware Cloud Foundation)-palvelu ja toimittajan tukipalvelut Hankinnan kohteena on Broadcomin VCSP-mallin mukaisesti toimitettava VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) -käyttöoikeus- ja lisensointikokonaisuus (jäljempänä VCF-palvelu) sekä erikseen tilattavat Toimittajan tukipalvelut. VCF-palveluun tulee sisältyä palvelun tuottamiseksi tarvittavat käyttöoikeudet, lisenssit ja muut pakolliset komponentit. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat tarkemmat vaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Tilaajana toimii Meidän IT ja talous Oy (Meita). Hankintasopimus tehdään yhden valitun Toimittajan kanssa, ja sopimusta käyttää ainoastaan Tilaaja. Meitan asiakkaat eivät ole kilpailutuksen tai sen perusteella tehtävän hankintasopimuksen sopijapuolia. Sopimuksen mukaisten Palvelujen tulee olla Tilaajan käytettävissä viimeistään 1.4.2027. Tilaajalla ei ole käytössään VCF-palveluun liittyviä Advanced Services -palveluita eikä Tilaaja edellytä niiden sisällyttämistä tarjottavaan palveluun. Mikäli Broadcomin sovellettavat ehdot kuitenkin edellyttävät VCF-palvelun toimittamiseksi vDefend-lisensointia tai muuta vastaavaa komponenttia, tästä aiheutuvat kustannukset tulee sisällyttää tarjoushintaan. Tarjoushinnan tulee kattaa kaikki VCF-palvelun toimittamisen edellyttämät kustannukset, jotka ovat Broadcomin tarjouksen jättöhetkellä VCSP-kumppaneille antaman virallisen tiedon perusteella pakollisia, mukaan lukien VCF-, VCSP-, lisensointi-, minimum commit-, attach- ja muut vastaavat kustannukset. title: France – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire pour la RTM et ses filiales (5 lots)
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la prestation de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire pour la RTM et ses filiales. L'EPIC Régie des Transports Métropolitains et ses filiales, ci-après dénommés collectivement « Groupe RTM », sont constitués en groupement de commandes en application des articles L. 2113-6 à L. 2113-8 du Code de la commande publique. En application des articles L2113-6 à L2113-8 du Code de la commande publique, le groupement de commande est constitué de 5 membres : RTM, RTM Est Métropole, RTM Ouest Métropole, Transcool 13, Transport Pays de l'Etoile. Ces prestations sont décomposées en cinq (5) lots désignés comme suit : Lot n°1 : Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire relevant des métiers administratifs Lot n°2 : Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire relevant des métiers de la logistique Lot n°3 : Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire relevant des métiers techniques et de la maintenance Lot n°4 : Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire relevant des métiers de l'exploitation de transports Lot n°5 : Prestations de mise à disposition de personnel intérimaire relevant des métiers de l'informatique Le présent marché public est un accord-cadre au sens des articles L.2125-1.1° et R.2162-1 et suivants du Code. Les accords-cadres sont multiattributaires, conclu avec plusieurs opérateurs économiques (au minimum 3 titulaires et au maximum 5 titulaires pour chacun des lots, sous réserve d'un nombre suffisant de candidatures et d'offres appropriées) et selon les modalités d'attribution définies ci-après. Toutefois, si le nombre d'offres régulières, acceptables et appropriées est inférieur à trois, l'acheteur pourra attribuer l'accord-cadre à un nombre inférieur de titulaires. En application de l'article R2162-4 du Code, les lots sont conclus sans montant minimum d'engagement et avec un montant maximum d'engagement sur leur durée initiale d'un an, à savoir : - Lot 1 : 300 000 euros HT - Lot 2 : 1 050 000 euros HT - Lot 3 : 1 050 000 euros HT - Lot 4 : 1 050 000 euros HT - Lot 5 : 300 000 euros HT Pour chaque période de reconduction d'un an chacune, le montant maximum d'engagement est identique Il s'agit de marchés publics de services qui se réfèrent au Cahier des Clauses Administratives Générales applicable aux marchés publics de fournitures courantes et de services (CCAG/FCS), approuvé par l'arrêté du 30 mars 2021.

Building and Grounds Maintenance Building envelope, doors, foundations, exterior systems, grounds, drainage, and basic infrastructure support Materials Management Procurement, storage, inventory, tracking, accountability, and installation of materials, parts, and spares. description: REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires a qualified General Contractor to complete construction-phase upgrades to the Water Treatment Plant control system at Riding Mountain National Park. The work includes upgrading the existing Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) systems, together with associated hardware, software, control panels, communications, electrical connections, operator interfaces, and field-device integration. The Construction Contractor will supply and install the required equipment; develop or modify PLC and SCADA programming; integrate the upgraded system with existing plant processes and instrumentation; complete testing, start-up, commissioning, operator training, and closeout documentation; and correct deficiencies. All work must be coordinated with Parks Canada and plant operators to maintain safe and continuous water-treatment operations. Planned shutdowns, system cutovers, and temporary control arrangements require prior approval. buyer: Direktion für Sicherheit, Umwelt und Energie
title: Tierpark Bern Dählhölzli, Neu- und Ersatzbauten, 291 Architekturleistungen, Studienauftrag mit 2 Lose
description:
La Ville de Berne gère plusieurs installations zoologiques sous le nom de « Tierpark Bern » (Parc zoologique de Berne). Elle offre à la population des possibilités de détente et des expériences personnelles, transmet et développe des connaissances sur la faune et la flore, et sensibilise le public à la détention des animaux dans le respect de leurs besoins, ainsi qu’à la protection de la nature et des espèces. Le Tierpark Bern comprend notamment les sites du Dählhölzli et du Parc aux ours (Bären Park). Afin de répondre aux besoins d’un nombre croissant de visiteurs et d’assurer une détention des animaux adaptée à leurs besoins, des investissements sont prévus dans les infrastructures et les enclos existants ainsi que dans de nouvelles installations. Par ailleurs, des mesures sont envisagées pour améliorer les conditions de travail du personnel. Parallèlement, le Tierpark Bern entend accorder une attention accrue, à l’avenir, aux défis posés par le changement climatique et la perte de biodiversité. Le périmètre du projet abrite en outre des habitats et des espèces protégés par la Loi fédérale sur la protection de la nature et du paysage (LPN) ; leur préservation, ou une compensation équivalente, doit impérativement être prise en compte lors du développement du projet.


La réalisation de ces objectifs implique des transformations spatiales. Il s’agit de créer de nouvelles installations et de remplacer celles qui sont vétustes. De plus, l’accès au site du Dählhölzli doit être amélioré pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Cette démarche constitue un élément essentiel de la planification globale du Tierpark Bern pour la période 2023–2033, laquelle décrit en détail la vision et la stratégie de ce qui se veut être « le parc zoologique le plus charmant de Suisse ».

title: Finland – Construction-related services – Työmaavalvonnan asiantuntijapalvelut 2027-2028 ja optiot vuosille 2029 ja 2030 (puitejärjestely)
description: Hankinta toteutetaan hankintarenkaana, johon kuuluvat Jyväskylän kaupunki (Tilapalvelu-liikelaitos ja kaikki toimialat), Jyväskylän Ammattikorkeakoulu Oy (JAMK), Kiinteistö Oy Tikkakosken Terveysasema ja Kiinteistö Oy Jyväskylän Lääkäritalo. Hankinnan kohteena on työmaavalvonnan asiantuntijapalvelujen puitejärjestely. Puitejärjestelyyn valitaan neljä (4) toimittajaa. Työmaavalvonnan palvelut muodostavat osan rakentamisen asiantuntijapalvelujen hankintakokonaisuudesta. Kokonaisuus on jaettu palvelualueittain erillisiin hankintoihin. Palvelualueet poikkeavat toisistaan tehtäväsisältönsä ja tarvittavan erityisosaamisen osalta siten, että niiden kilpailuttaminen erillisinä hankintoina on tarkoituksenmukaista. Kukin palvelualue kilpailutetaan erillisessä hankintamenettelyssä ja ratkaistaan erillisellä hankintapäätöksellä. Kyseessä on aiemmin keskeytetyn hankinnan uudelleen kilpailutus. Aiempi hankintamenettely keskeytettiin hankintayksikön havaittua tarjouspyynnössä virheen, jonka korjaaminen kesken hankintamenettelyn ei ollut mahdollista vaarantamatta hankintamenettelyn avoimuutta ja tarjoajien tasapuolista kohtelua. Uudessa kilpailutuksessa rakennuttamisen ja työmaavalvonnan palvelut on erotettu toisistaan erillisiksi hankinnoiksi. Lisäksi tarjouspyyntöä on täsmennetty aiemmassa hankintamenettelyssä esitettyjen kysymysten perusteella. Puitejärjestelyn sopimuskausi on 2027–2028. Hankintaan sisältyvät optiokaudet vuosille 2029 ja 2030. Puitejärjestelyn ennakoitu kokonaisarvo, mukaan lukien mahdolliset optiokaudet, on 1 700 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Puitejärjestelyn enimmäisarvo on 1 900 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Enimmäisarvo sisältää varauksen sopimuskauden aikana ilmeneviin ennakolta vaikeasti arvioitaviin hankintatarpeisiin. Enimmäisarvo ei muodosta hankintayksiköille määräostovelvoitetta eikä toimittajille oikeutta tiettyyn hankintamäärään. Puitejärjestelyn perusteella tehtävien hankintojen yhteenlaskettu arvo voi olla enintään 1 900 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Enimmäisarvon saavuttamisen jälkeen puitejärjestelyyn perustuvia uusia tilauksia ei tehdä.

description: *****AMENDMENT 0002 START*****Revises and Replaces: a) 00 21 00 Instructions - ProjNet & PIEE, b) 00 73 00 --Supplementary Conditions. Updated Plans and Specs provided. Bid Opening call-in information remains as stated in the solicitation.*****AMENDMENT 0001 END*****This solicitation is for construction services required for HVAC and Fire Suppression systems repair of Building 1203 at March Air Reserve Base, CA. This is an Invitation For Bid, sealed bid procurement. The solicitation notice will be posted to SAM.gov 4 November 2026 by Close of Business.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Louisville District hereby issues an Invitation for Bid (IFB), Solicitation No. W912QR27BA004, to renovate Building 1203-DOAS/AHU and Fire Suppression Water System, March Air Reserve Base, California. A description of the construction project is as follows:This work consists of, but is not limited to, installing a new Dedicated Outside Air System (DOAS) air handling unit, the replacement of Air Handling Unit (AHU-02) and the replacement of the existing waterline that ties the main waterline to Building 1203. The distance of waterline to be replaced is estimated to be 100-ft. Additional site-work will include a larger housekeeping pad, larger equipment access platform, and larger landscaped enclosure to accommodate the additional DOAS air handling unit. New outside air supply and return ductwork will be incorporated leading from the DOAS unit to the rooms served by AHU-02 providing direct-to-room ventilation. The Contract Duration is 500 calendar days from Administrative Notice to Proceed.TYPE OF CONTRACT AND NAICS: This IFB is intended to result in the award of one Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. If at the time of award an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror. title: 9905--Equipment - Main Lobby Wayfinding Signage - Source Sought Notice
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY� � This is a Sources Sought Notice issued solely for market research purposes to determine the availability and capability of Small Businesses, including SDVOSB and VOSB concerns, under NAICS 339950 with a size standard of 500 employees. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) New Jersey Health Care System (VANJHCS) is in need to upgrade the East Orange Main Lobby signage and wayfinding system to improve navigation, enhance user experience, and meet current code and VHA requirements. The project is crucial to the user s experience at the facility, code compliance and to ensure Veterans, their families and personnel can quickly and easily navigate the facility. As the first point of contact, the lobby must present clear, well organized information with a strong visual hierarchy, as consistency in messaging and design helps establish trust. Currently, public entrances lack clear identification, VA branding, and required policy communication, and the lobby s signage is outdated, inconsistent, and not aligned with VHA guidelines. Although space features historic Art Deco architecture, it is overshadowed by significant wayfinding challenges. VHA design guidelines also notes that interior signage systems more than 15 years old typically require replacement due to organizational changes and aging components. Project Scope:� The purpose of this project is to provide VA New Jersey Health Care System (VANJHCS) East Orange Main Lobby with a consistent, compliant, and user centered interior signage and wayfinding system. The signage hierarchy will identify the zone first (A, B, C, or D), followed by the department to direct visitors efficiently. Project Performance Time The contractor performance period shall be 80 calendar days from Notice to Proceed. Installation date shall be no later than 7/15/2027, which includes time needed to submit, review and approve all drawings, submittals, temporary storage if needed, installations, and final inspection. After work begins on the site, the contractor shall work continuously after working hours and on weekends only; a representative from the furniture vendor shall be present until the completion of the contract. Location & Access: 385 Tremont Ave, East Orange, NJ 07018-1023 Building 1, Main Lobby at A Level Interested party please see attached Source Sought 36C24227Q161 for details. Response Requirements: Interested and capable vendors are requested to provide the following information: Company name, address, and point of contact information UEI number and SAM registration status Business size/type: Large, Small, SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), etc. Capability statement demonstrating experience supplying surgical or endoscopic instruments Indication of ability to provide brand name or equal compatible products Product literature for equal items (if applicable) Estimated delivery times. Any existing contract vehicles (GSA, SAC, VA FSS, DAPA, etc.) through which the items may be purchased. Any applicable warranty information. Responses are due no later than� 10:00 AM Eastern Time on December 10, 2026.� � This notice does not constitute a solicitation. No contract will be awarded based on this announcement. The VA will not reimburse costs associated with responding to this Sources Sought. Responses will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy (e.g., SDVOSB set aside, VOSB set aside, Small Business set aside, or unrestricted).� No proprietary, classified, or sensitive information should be included in responses. No phone calls will be accepted. This notice is for planning purposes only and will assist the VA in determining appropriate acquisition strategy, including potential set aside decisions.

title: Q511--Ophthalmology Health Technician Services
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE This is a SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE for market research purposes to determine the availability of qualified sources capable of providing OPTHALMOLOGY HEALTH TECHNICIAN SERVICES. Responses will be used to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy for a potential future acquisition. Please clearly identify any information your company considers sensitive or proprietary. OPTHALMOLOGY HEALTH TECHNICIAN SERVICES: The Contractor shall provide Ophthalmology (Ophthalmic) Health Technician Services on site at the Twin Ports VA Clinic, 3520 Tower Avenue, Superior, WI 54880, in accordance with the specifications contained herein to beneficiaries of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the Minneapolis VA Health Care System (MVAHCS). Ophthalmology (Ophthalmic) Health Technicians in the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) assist Ophthalmologists and/or Optometrists with eye exams and refractions, vision testing, screening, and diagnostic imaging. Ophthalmology (Ophthalmic) Health Technicians will room patients, stock and clean exam rooms. Ophthalmic Health Technician shall provide optical services in addition to clinical duties. These include fitting, ordering, repairing, and adjusting glasses for patients during clinical hours. The Contractor s provider (s) assigned by the Contractor to perform the services covered by this contract shall have a current license to practice medicine in any State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States or the District of Columbia) when services are performed onsite on VA property. All licenses held by the key personnel working on this contract shall be full and unrestricted licenses. Contractor s provider (s) who have current, full and unrestricted licenses in one or more states, but who have, or ever had, a license restricted, suspended, revoked, voluntarily revoked, voluntarily surrendered pending action or denied upon application will not be considered for the purposes of this contract. Contract personnel must be certified as a Certified Ophthalmic Medical Technologist (COMT), Certified Ophthalmic Technician (COT), or Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) by the Joint Commission on Allied Health Personnel in Ophthalmology (JCAHPO). All continuing education courses required for maintaining certification must be always kept current. This is a follow-on requirement. The anticipated contract is firm fixed price contract with services estimated to commence on September 1st, 2027. All companies wishing to do business with the U.S. Government must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://www.sam.gov/. Please note that there is no fee to register in SAM. If the procurement is set aside for Veteran-owned businesses only, firms must be verified in the Department of Veterans Affairs, Vendor Information Pages (VIP) at Veteran Small Business Certification (sba.gov). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 621320, Offices of Optometrists If you are a potential interested vendor, please provide the following information: 1. Company Name 2. Company Address 3. SAM Unique Entity ID 4. Company Point of Contact (POC) 5. Company POC Phone Number 6. Company POC Email 7. Company Website 8. A Statement of capability to deliver the services listed above, including a list of existing federal contracts for similar services, if available. The capability statement request is not a Request for Quotations, Request for Proposals, or Invitation for Bids, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach, but rather the Government is requesting information regarding your company's ability to provide the services listed above. Any commercial brochures or currently existing marketing material may also be submitted with the capabilities statement. The capabilities will used to determine if the acquisition will be set-aside for small business or if it will be an unrestricted procurement (all business size). Other than small businesses (i.e., large businesses) are requested to respond to this notice in the event the market does not indicate enough small business interest to support a set-aside. This posting is for information and planning purposes only and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government. The Government will not pay for information solicited. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the market research. Additionally, a response to this sources sought notice is not a request to be added to a prospective bidders list or to receive a copy of any forthcoming solicitation. Thank you for your participation and interest in serving our nation s Veterans. Please email information to Morgan.Galer@va.gov. Include Sources Sought Notice 36C26327Q0133 in the Subject field of your email. See attached document: Sources Sought Notice Response Form.

title: S208--TREE CARE MANAGEMENT SERVICE
description: TREE CARE MANAGEMENT SERVICES The Tomah VA Medical Center Forest has significant historic, health and ecological value. Management and maintenance efforts are aimed at preserving these characteristics, promoting biodiversity, and ensuring the long-term health and safety of the forest ecosystem. The VA is seeking a contractor with the capability and capacity to perform comprehensive tree removal, trimming, tree health management, new tree planting, and long-term forest management planning to preserve the health and ecological value of the forest. A Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials, transportation, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to remove hazardous trees, provide trimming, identify hazards, provide tree health management activities, provide new tree selection and placement, clean up debris, and produce a 5-year forest management plan.

title: Y--Rocky Mountain Region Industry Day
description: Indian Affairs (IA)is pleased to announce the Rocky Mountain Region Industry Day. Indian Affairs gives preference to Indian Economic Enterprises IEEs) and Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs), and is especially interested in attendance by local, Indian-owned small businesses working in the construction sector. Rocky Mountain Region has many small and moderately sized construction projects and we wish to develop our relationship with local ISBEEs who can help us meet these needs. Many of our projects are for roof repair or replacement, HVAC system repair or replacement, and electrical or plumbing work. Specialized contractors are welcome, as well as general contractors. We would also like to help local, Indian-owned small businesses that have not done business with the Federal government or Indian Affairs before to understand the requirements for ISBEE status as well as the general process for obtaining Federal contracts. Local contractors will have their offices located in Montana or Wyoming. This Industry Day will provide businesses with: � Information on upcoming contracting opportunities � Guidance on the Buy Indian Act procurement process � Resources to help businesses successfully compete for federal contracts The event will be attended by Bureau of Indian Affairs Rocky Mountain regional facilities staff and Indian Affairs contracting officers specializing in construction and related services. Event Details: Indian Affairs Rocky Mountain Regional Industry Day December 10th, 2026 Billings Doubletree 27 N 27th St Billings, MT 59101-2314 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM There is no charge to attend! Registration Contractors may register by emailing Jessica Kidd at jessica.kidd@bia.gov or Kurt Egner at kurt.egner@bia.gov. title: Belgium – Architectural services for buildings – Aanstellen ontwerper: Renovatie en herbestemming van de Villa Vande Walle
description: De herbestemming van Villa Vande Walle vormt een belangrijke eerste stap in de ontwikkeling van de Kunstensite De Spil. Naar aanleiding van de realisatie van de nieuwe academie voor het deeltijds kunstonderwijs ontstaat een unieke culturele campus waar onderwijs, creatie, presentatie en ontmoeting elkaar versterken. Binnen deze bredere context, met De Spil, de Heilig-Hartkerk, het stadspark en de nieuwe academie als belangrijke ankerpunten, krijgt de Villa een nieuwe maatschappelijke en culturele betekenis. De Stad Roeselare wil Villa Vande Walle ontwikkelen tot een gedeelde culturele werkplek voor Stad Roeselare, Academieplus en De Spil. De Villa wordt een complementaire plek binnen de kunstensite: geen klassiek cultuurgebouw, maar een flexibele werk- en ontwikkelomgeving waar kunstenaars, studenten, cultuurprofessionals en publiek elkaar ontmoeten. De Villa krijgt een duidelijke focus op kunsteducatie, artistieke ontwikkeling, creatie, residentie, presentatie en experiment. Ze biedt ruimte aan zowel professionele kunstenaars als jonge makers en studenten om te onderzoeken, te creëren en hun werk te tonen. Het gebouw wordt daarmee opnieuw een levendige plek waar erfgoed en hedendaagse cultuur elkaar ontmoeten en waar creativiteit, samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. De Villa Vande Walle zal daarbij een duurzaam gebouw worden. Er zal daarom maximaal ingezet worden op het beperken van het energieverbruik en het aanwenden van duurzame energiebronnen. De concrete ontwerpopdracht voor deze nieuwe culturele hotspot omvat volgende deelaspecten: - Het herbestemmen van de Villa Vande Walle tot een gedeelde culturele werkplek van de Stad Roeselare, Academieplus (de eengemaakte kunstacademie van podium en beeldende kunsten) en het cultuurhuis De Spil. Dit omvat het ontwikkelen van een toekomstgerichte visie voor de site als samenhangend geheel van cultuur, educatie en ontmoeting, met aandacht voor haar rol en inbedding in de ruimere omgeving. - Een bouwfysisch en energetisch luik als onderdeel van de noodzakelijke renovatie van de Villa Vande Walle. Een grondige energetische renovatie vormt daarom een essentiële randvoorwaarde voor de toekomst van Villa Vandewalle. Hierbij wordt bijzondere aandacht besteed aan oplossingen die verenigbaar zijn met de erfgoedwaarde van het gebouw en resulteren in een doordacht energiebeheer. Naast de energetische ingrepen is ook een bouwfysische renovatie noodzakelijk. Een geïntegreerde bouwfysische aanpak zorgt ervoor dat de renovatie niet alleen energie-efficiënt is, maar ook duurzaam en gezond voor zowel het gebouw als zijn gebruikers. Op deze manier wordt de levensduur van het erfgoed verlengd en worden toekomstige onderhouds- en herstelkosten beperkt. Zo wordt het mogelijk om de historische en architecturale waarde van het gebouw voor toekomstige generaties veilig te stellen. - De uitwerking van de buitenaanleg en landschappelijke inpassing van het gebouw in zijn bestaande omgeving is daarbij een aandachtspunt. Er dient onderzocht hoe de relatie tussen de Villa en het park versterkt kan worden. De opdracht betreft een complexe opdracht die bestaat uit verschillende deelopdrachten die allemaal op elkaar moeten worden afgestemd om tot één geïntegreerd geheel te komen. Een toekomstvisie voor de Villa moet ontwikkeld worden, geïntegreerd in zijn omgeving.

title: W065--IDIQ Hospital Bed Rental and Maintenance Services for Texas VA Medical Centers
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 17, is conducting market research to identify qualified vendors capable of providing hospital bed rental and maintenance services in support of Veteran care throughout the State of Texas. The information obtained from this RFI will be used to determine the availability of capable sources and assist the Government in acquisition planning for a potential Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. This announcement is for informational and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a solicitation. Requirement Description The VA has a requirement for the rental, delivery, setup, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, repair, replacement, pickup, and related support services for hospital beds used in the care of Veterans at VA Medical Centers, Community Living Centers, Community-Based Outpatient Clinics, and other authorized locations throughout Texas. The anticipated contract will support multiple VA healthcare facilities located within the Texas Veterans Health Care System. Specific performance locations and technical requirements are detailed in the attached Statement of Work (SOW). Services may include, but are not limited to: Rental of standard and specialty hospital beds. Delivery, installation, and setup of hospital beds. Preventive maintenance and inspection services. Corrective maintenance and repair services. Emergency repair and replacement services. Removal and pickup of equipment. Compliance with all applicable Federal, State, Joint Commission, OSHA, and VA requirements. Documentation and reporting of maintenance activities. Available inventory of hospital beds and specialty beds. Delivery and response capabilities, including emergency services. Quality control procedures. Staffing and technical qualifications. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Objective 5: Integrated Test and Diagnostics: The DIFS shall incorporate built-in test capabilities to generate, capture, and analyze Digital IF streams to allow for rapid troubleshooting, performance verification (e.g., Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) & spectral purity), and subsystem health monitoring with minimal operational burden and with on-site test equipment. Objective 6: Resilient and Maintainable Design (Resilient): The commercial solution shall be designed for high availability Ai ? 0.9998) a long service life (15 years), and rapid maintainability (MTTR ? 30 minutes), using standard line-replaceable items (LRIs). Objective 7: Secure and Compliant Architecture (Secure): The subsystem design shall be capable of achieving a Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization for a security categorization of (Confidentiality, Moderate), (Integrity, Moderate), (Availability, Moderate). This Request for Information (RFI) is in support of Market Research being conducted by the United States Census Bureau (USCB) to gather general information and explore potential available solutions to support the agency�s need. This is not a Request for Proposal/Request for Quote or an indication that a contractual commitment will exist for this requirement. The Government does not intend to award a contract solely on the basis of this market research. No funds are necessarily obligated for any requirement or solicitation that may or may not ultimately arise from the results of this market research. The purpose of this tentative requirement is to promptly onboard expertise to support the Regional and Decennial infrastructure required to conduct large scale, time sensitive field operations. This includes the technical support needed to implement new training for Field operations and the systems that support hiring, training, pay and data collection efforts and the resulting analysis. This contract vehicle will provide support for current surveys, Decennial Census data collection, and geographic operations, including pre-2030 Decennial Census tests and objectives. A large portion of the support to assist in opening over 90 temporary offices from which hiring, training, coordinating material distribution, data collection, and payroll efforts will be administered or managed. Securing those office leases requires multiple staff with the knowledge and expertise to negotiate and secure lease and equipment agreements, Federal Protective Services, HVAC needs, space buildout, supplies, electrical, and network setup, this includes receiving equipment deliveries, setting up, and managing these temporary spaces the same as our permanent government spaces. Ultimately, Field Division must dismantle the infrastructure and release staff as promptly as they were secured. Contractual support staff are ideal for these monumental efforts. The services will be provided via the issuance of fixed price, time and material, or a combination of both call order types will enable FLD to obtain contractual support for divisions and program offices at Headquarters (HQ) to support the Census mission. The Contractor shall provide the services listed in Task Area 1 through 17 under Agreement Requirements. These Task Areas include but are not limited to; assisting in technical and operational writing, automated training development, infrastructure, recruiting, space planning, personnel and payroll, training development, training delivery, scheduling, training support, help desk support, SharePoint support, database engineering and administration, analytical and quantitative analysis.

These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. title: Mesh and Hydrodynamic Framework for Shellfish Water Classification Program
description: This solicitation aims to collect and organize physical oceanographic data into a usable format for Environment and Climate Change Canada. The data will support the development of accurate hydrodynamic models to predict fecal coliform contamination in coastal and intertidal areas during both planned and unplanned events. These models and frameworks will enable ECCC Shellfish Water Classification Program (ECCC-SWCP) Engineers to evaluate potential water quality conditions in shellfish harvest waters near possible sanitary pollution sources. The information generated from this project will support the ECCC delivery of a wastewater assessment and hydrodynamic modelling to inform shellfish harvesters on sanitary pollution contamination.

title: Install Generator- FCI Bastrop
description: Amendment 0002- Time Extension Amendment 0001- Correct Set Aside error in the Instruction to Offerors Solicitation The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) is issuing solicitation 15BBNF27Q50100001 for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project entitled Install Generator at the Federal Correctional Institution (FCI Bastrop), located in Bastrop, TX. FCI Bastrop is a federal correctional facility located at 1341 Highway 95 North, Bastrop, TX, 78602. The project consists of the following: replace the existing 750 KW Generator, load bank, and 3-way Main Switchgear and install one (1) new 2000 KW Diesel Generator and Switchgear system. See the Statement of Work/Specifications attachment included with the solicitation posting for the complete requirements of the work. The performance period for the project will be 420 Calendar Days from issuance of the notice to proceed. The NAICS code for this requirement is 238210 with a corresponding small business size standard of $19 million. The solicitation will be distributed solely through the Contract Opportunity website at https://www.sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be made available. The website provides download instructions. The "Sensitive /Secure package Upload" option will be selected for this procurement. All secure/locked documents uploaded, to include the solicitation, will require an active SAM vendor registration to obtain access. In addition, only those vendors who have been issued a valid Marketing Partner Identification Number (MPIN) from www.sam.gov will be granted access. If your firm does not have the NAICS code listed in www.sam.gov required for this solicitation, an email may be forwarded to your firm requesting an explanation as to why your firm should be granted access. If you encounter problems accessing these documents, please contact the Federal Service Desk at 866-606-8220. All future information about this solicitation, including any amendments, will also be distributed solely through this website. Interested parties are responsible for continuously monitoring this website to ensure that they have the most recent information about this proposed contract action. IMPORTANT: Any contractor interested in obtaining a contract award with the Federal Bureau of Prisons must be registered in https://www.sam.gov. In order to qualify for award, your business size metrics information entered in your www.sam.gov SAM registration must be less than or equal to the size standard specified above. Each bidder's www.sam.gov registration will be reviewed by the Government to confirm that your business size meets the small business size standard requirement. All bidders are urged to double check their www.sam.gov registration and update as necessary, including the size metrics information. This is a 100 percent small business set-aside. You must be registered in www.sam.gov as a small business for the applicable NAICS code (see FAR provision 52.219-1 in the Representations & Certifications section of your www.sam.gov registration).

title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT FROM A SINGLE SOURCE - Environmental Modeling Technical Support and EEMS Workshop Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT A SINGLE SOURCE Environmental Modeling Technical Support and EEMS Workshop Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project Notice ID: W912EP27Z1CYM NAICS: 541620 | PSC: B510 Proposed Source: DSI, LLC | UEI: MBMESK928KP3 Response Deadline: 10 December 2026 at 2:00PM EST The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Jacksonville District, intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price contract to DSI, LLC, on a single-source basis pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) RFO 6.302-1 Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This notice is issued to inform industry of the Government�s intent and to invite capability statements from firms that believe they can meet the requirement. This is not a request for quotations or proposals; no solicitation is available at this time. The requirement supports the Jacksonville Harbor Deepening Project�s environmental modeling activities, including assessment of salinity conditions in the Lower St. Johns River. The anticipated period of performance is 12 months. The required services include: � Preparation of customized workshop materials using the Government�s existing Jacksonville Harbor modeling files and relevant assessment scenarios; � One five-day, instructor-led, hands-on workshop for Government personnel covering the current EFDC+ Explorer Modeling System (EEMS), including EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+, as applied to model configuration, calibration, validation, salinity analysis, scenario evaluation, post-processing, and interpretation of results; and � Up to 50 hours of follow-on remote technical assistance and troubleshooting relating to the existing EEMS modeling workflow. The acquisition does not include purchase of a perpetual EEMS software license or three years of software maintenance. DSI has represented that it developed and solely owns EEMS and maintains the source code for EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+. DSI further represents that knowledge of current-release features, workflows, and model options depends on its recent software development work; that it provides customized training and technical support directly to U.S. clients; and that it has no licensed or authorized U.S. distributors, resellers, or agents. Based on the Government�s current technical assessment and market research, USACE anticipates that DSI is the only source reasonably available to provide the required current-release, developer-level training and technical assistance. The Government will consider information submitted in response to this notice before making a final acquisition decision. Interested responsible sources may submit a written capability statement demonstrating their ability to meet the complete requirement. Responses should specifically address current-release EEMS expertise; the ability to provide project-specific, hands-on training and follow-on troubleshooting for EFDC+, EFDC+ Explorer, and Grid+; access to the technical knowledge needed to support the current release without reliance on DSI; relevant experience; and the proposed approach and timeframe for performance. General environmental modeling experience or familiarity with earlier software versions, without evidence of capability to meet the stated current-release requirements, may not establish the ability to perform this requirement. Submit capability statements electronically to Ligaya Lowe, Contract Specialist, at ligaya.m.lowe@usace.army.mil, with a copy to Gerald Garvey, Contracting Officer, at gerald.l.garvey@usace.army.mil, no later than the response deadline stated above. Include the firm�s legal name, UEI, point of contact, and a concise description of relevant capabilities. Telephone responses will not be accepted. All timely responses will be reviewed solely to determine whether a competitive acquisition approach is appropriate. A determination not to complete this proposed acquisition, based on responses to this notice, is within the Government�s discretion and will be documented in the acquisition file. The Government is not obligated to issue a solicitation or reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice.

title: Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC)
description: ****Related Prior Solicitation Number W911XK26RA012 and W911XK27BA002**** The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking contractors with the capability to provide environmental (mechanical) dredging and placement of contaminated sediment construction services in the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC) located in Riverview, Michigan. The project consist of work associated with the environmental maintenance dredging of the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel located in Riverview, Michigan. There are no options included with the solicitation. The channel is situated just south of Bridge Road and the Grosse Ile Toll Bridge. The primary goal of the project is to remove contaminated sediment from Sediment Management Area 1 (maximum 4 feet depth) and Area 2 (maxi-mum 25 feet depth). Approximately 28,100 cubic yards of material is planned to be re-moved using mechanical dredging means with transport and placement of the contaminated dredged material into Cell 5 of the Pointe Mouillee Confined Disposal Facility (CDF).

title: Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC)
description: *****Amendment 0001***** Amendment 0001 is being issued to update Section 00 21 13 - Instruction to Bidders 3. Site Visit. All other terms and conditions remain UNCHANGED.**********Related Prior Solicitation Number W911XK26RA012 and W911XK27BA002**** The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking contractors with the capability to provide environmental (mechanical) dredging and placement of contaminated sediment construction services in the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC) located in Riverview, Michigan. The project consist of work associated with the environmental maintenance dredging of the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel located in Riverview, Michigan. There are no options included with the solicitation. The channel is situated just south of Bridge Road and the Grosse Ile Toll Bridge. The primary goal of the project is to remove contaminated sediment from Sediment Management Area 1 (maximum 4 feet depth) and Area 2 (maxi-mum 25 feet depth). Approximately 28,100 cubic yards of material is planned to be re-moved using mechanical dredging means with transport and placement of the contaminated dredged material into Cell 5 of the Pointe Mouillee Confined Disposal Facility (CDF).

ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP), Field Acquisition Office (FAO), intends to award a single-award Purchase Order with firm-fixed unit pricing for Immersive Virtual Reality (VR) Training System at the Management & Specialty Training Center (MSTC) in Aurora, Colorado. This acquisition is being conducted as a total small business set-aside under the authority of FAR Part 19. The applicable North American Industrial Classification (NAICS) code is 333310, Commercial and Service Industry Machinery Manufacturing, and the associated small business size standard applies. The anticipated purchase term is for a one-time purchase with no option periods. The solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and will be posted on SAM.gov. An award will be given to the quoter whose quotation represents the best value to the Government considering price, past performance, and technical factors identified in the solicitation. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, transportation, labor, supervision, and materials necessary to perform Immersive Virtual Reality (VR) Training System in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW). The solicitation RFQ package, including the Statement of Work, pricing schedule, provisions, and clauses, will be available through SAM.gov. Interested vendors are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for amendments and additional information related to this solicitation. The solicitation incorporates applicable provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at Acquisition.gov. In accordance to FAR 52.204-7, System for Award Management (SAM), quoters must be actively registered in the SAM at the time of quotation submission and prior to award. Quoters shall provide their Unique Entity Identification (UEI) with their quotation. Registration information can be found at: Sam.gov. Vendors seeking assistance with SAM registration or federal contracting opportunities may contact their local APEX Accelerator. Additional information is available at: Apexaccelerators.us Quotations shall be submitted in accordance with the �Quotation Submission Instructions� contained in Section L of the solicitation. Completed quotations, including Standard Form (SF) 1449 and all required supporting documentation, shall be submitted via email to LaQueta Wheeler at LLWheeler@bop.gov no later than the date and time in Block 8 of the SF-1449. Questions regarding this solicitation shall be submitted in writing via email no later than Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 10:00 AM CST. Section L of the solicitation provides quotation preparation instructions, evaluation factors, and award methodology, including any required supporting documentation.

title: Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS)
description: The Sources Sought results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this solicitation will be unrestricted competition or a small business set-aside for C-Type contract to fulfill Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) requirements. The Government is assessing the capability of companies that may possess the expertise to competently and competitively respond to the following requirements for the SCARS program: For the SCARS Program, the contractor shall possess the capabilities to fulfill 1) Security Operations Center (SOC) Operations, 2) Remote Assessment & Authorization, 3) Software Patching Baseline Integrity, 4) Maintain a SCARS Library, 5) Edge Virtualization & Modern Deployment on SCARS On-Premise Equipment (OPE), 6) Network Integration & Management, 7) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), 8) Governance of Architecture Standards, 9) Enterprise Logistics & Fielding, 10) Data Requirements and 11) Security Requirements. The contract will commence CY2030 with an anticipated transition period up to six (6) months leading to full operational performance in CY 2031. The anticipated structure includes a 4-year base period with six 1-year option periods and an optional 6-month extension of services (RFO 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services). All projected dates and contact structures are notional and subject to change based on market research and acquisition strategy approval. The Government anticipates the use of: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Contract Line-item Numbers (CLINs): Services Cost Reimbursable CLINs: Travel and studies/analysis tasks Other: CLIN may be of any type authorized Further questions may be e-mailed to Contracting Officer, Steve Godby, steven.godby@us.af.mil, Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil, and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil. Responses must be submitted via email to Contracting Officer, Anne Torian, anne.torian@us.af.mil and Program Manager, Daniel Douglass, daniel.douglass.2@us.af.mil and are due NLT 3:00 PM EST, 10 December 2026. The Government may converse with respondents regarding this RFI. Such conversations are solely intended to clarify potential capability to perform the requirements.

title: Callao, Peru Infrastructure Modernization - U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) � Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA)
description: Amendment to the Sources Sought - November 10, 2026 The following questions have been added: How do our shipping restrictions affect your pricing, schedule, and risk? How does the Jones Act impact your logistics process, if at all? If regulations did not matter, what do you recommend to make the logistics and transportation process easier for US Government requirements? How does the Balance of Payments Program impact your list of suppliers? How frequent does the logistics process directly contribute to delays or cost increases? Have you lost revenue due to logistics delays/issues that could have been addressed earlier in the procurement process? ****SOURCES SOUGHT FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY**** This announcement seeks information from industry which will be used for preliminary planning purposes. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this announcement. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. 1. AGENCY: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA) 2. NAICS: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Peru 4. ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Facility / Scope Package Primary Function Key Technical Considerations Building 110 Spare Parts Warehouse Heavy-duty slab design, industrial racking integration, material handling flow, automated logistics staging. Building 115 Clothing & Gear Warehouse High-density pallet storage, humidity and climate control, inventory distribution bays. Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. SOURCES SOUGHT: The purpose of this source sought is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of contractors who have the capabilities to complete and perform contracts of this magnitude, and to address any questions, recommendations or concerns from Industry. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among potential pool of responsible contractors. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought announcement. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. 8. RESPONSES: The Capabilities Statement for this Sources Sought is not intended to be a Request for Proposal nor Invitation for Bid, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. It is to request statements regarding the company's ability to demonstrate existing-or-developed expertise and experience in relation to the areas specified herein. Any commercial brochures or currently existing marketing material may also be submitted. This synopsis is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement addressing the following areas. Section 1: Company Information Company Name, Address, and Website Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email) CAGE Code and SAM UEI

title: Request for Information (RFI) for the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP)
description: FEMA is modernizing the National Flood Insurance Program to improve how it assesses and communicates flood risk, prices and delivers flood insurance, manages floodplains, and provides mitigation assistance. The goal is to help individuals, communities, states, and private-sector partners better understand and reduce flood risk while using policyholder and taxpayer funds efficiently. To support this effort, FEMA is integrating staff, initiatives, and support structures into a more unified NFIP operating model. The draft contract support model described in the RFI pursues those outcomes. Work will be grouped into several categories described in the RFI. Not all current NFIP support contracts will be recompeted immediately. This document also identifies selected support structures and contracts that are not currently within the scope of this RFI to provide a more complete picture of the NFIP support environment. Please see attached RFI for complete details.

The Government�s need for procurement services is required to support current combat search and rescue missions. The TH-1H Helicopter is used by the Air Force to train helicopter pilots. This Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is part of the TH-1H helicopter's flight control systems. These are a series of mechanical linkages, actuated by conventional controls and are used to control flight attitude and direction. This actuator provides hydraulic assisted cyclic input from the pilot to the main rotor through the swashplate and collective input through the collective levers and scissor hub. The hydraulic actuator has an irreversible valve to reduce feedback forces and provide for minimum use of controls in event of hydraulic boost failure. The Cylinder Assembly is an Aviation Critical Safety Item (CSI). It must provide hydraulic-assisted cyclic input from the pilot to the main rotor. Failure to achieve its designed function will result in unacceptable probability of a class-A mishap, thus increasing the likelihood of loss of life. title: 155mm M231 and M232-Series Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Propelling Charges
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command � Rock Island at Picatinny (ACC-RI-PICA), Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey 07806-5000, on behalf of the Office of the Project Manager for Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), intends to issue a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) for the production of the M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant in support of the 155mm M231 and M232-Series Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Propelling Charges. The Government intends to award up to two Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (ID/IQ) production type contract(s) with five (5) one-year ordering periods, dependent upon Formal Source Selection Evaluations (Best Value with Subjective Tradeoffs). The MACS Propelling Charge consists of two solid propellant charges, the M231 (Low-Zone) and the M232-series (High-Zone), and their associated packaging. The charge system provides a complete zoning solution for the 155mm artillery applications by using multiples of the basic modules through a "build-a-charge" incremental system. The M231 charges are used singly or in pairs for Low Zones (1 and 2) and the M232-series is used in groups of three, four, or five charges for High Zones (3, 4, and 5, respectively). The M31A2 triple base propellant is specifically used for the M232-series high-zone charge to enhance Warfighter capabilities by eliminating the need for �cleaner� rounds between top-zone firings, reducing gun wear, and extending gun-tube life. This propellant is essential for effective artillery operations, supporting both combat missions and training requirements. The M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant is a vital component of the 155mm M231 and M232-series propelling charges, which are used in howitzer artillery systems. The MACS offers significant improvements in operational flexibility, performance, logistics, and costs compared to the previous generation of bag propelling charges. The total maximum aggregate contract value will be $2,316,202,800.00 , to include all contract awards. Throughout the 5-year ordering period, PM CAS may order any quantity of M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant as long as the total value of the orders does not exceed the combined contract maximum. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database by accessing the SAM web site at http://www.sam.gov in order to be eligible for contract award and all correspondence must be in English. Estimated time for release of the Solicitation is Quarter 2, FY27 (Q2FY27). However, if any interested sources intend to review, respond, and/or submit a response to the formal Solicitation; a DRAFT Solicitation is readily available to be provided via DOD SAFE. The MACS M31 Series-Type Triple Base Propellant will be in accordance with a Government Owned Technical Data Package (TDP). The TDP is coded as Distribution Statement D (Further Distribution authorized to the Department of War (DoW) and U.S. DoD contractors only. Other requests for this document must be referred to the controlling DoW office: PM CAS) and will be made available once the Solicitation has been released for this effort. A completed Military Critical Technical Data Agreement (AMSTA-AR Form 1350), and a completed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required prior to consideration to receiving the TDP. The POCs for any questions, DRAFT Solicitation, or the TDP request, this notification, and any requests/questions may be directed to Ms. Cameron Sacco at cameron.h.sacco.civ@army.mil and Mr. John Scott, at john.c.scott158.civ@army.mil. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.

title: Industry Day - USACE SPK Geotechnical Drilling and Laboratory Services
description: Special Notice: Virtual Industry Day Event Schedule & Platform Date of Event: December 10, 2026 (Thursday) Time: 1:00 PM � 2:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) Location/Platform: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (see below for details) Purpose of Event The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District (USACE-SPK) is pleased to announce a virtual Industry Day on December 10, 2026. The purpose of this session is to provide industry partners with a comprehensive overview of the upcoming Geotechnical Drilling Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Government will present details regarding program requirements, anticipated geographic scope, proposed technical evaluation factors (such as specialized rig fleet inventory and AASHTO/USACE MTC laboratory accreditation standards), and the tentative acquisition milestone schedule. USACE-SPK anticipates issuing a formal solicitation under NAICS 541360in February 2027., and highly encourage participation from regional small businesses, prospective joint venture partners, and specialty subcontractors who intend to compete. Scope of Work and Technical Capabilities USACE-SPK seeks firms with the capabilities to provide comprehensive geotechnical drilling, cone penetrometer testing (CPT) services, and test-pit excavations utilizing backhoes and track hoes. The principal features of the work encompass soil drilling and sampling utilizing hollow-stem flight augers, solid-stem flight augers, mud-rotary, air-rotary, and percussion drilling methods, including ODEX, Down-hole Casing Advance Systems, or other specialized percussion drilling systems. Contract requirements will also mandate sonic drilling and sampling, alongside rock core drilling and sampling of up to 6-inch diameter using wireline or conventional diamond-impregnated drill bits. Soil sampling operations will require standard penetrometers and other split-barrel samplers up to 3-inch-diameter, as well as undisturbed soil sampling using Shelby push tubes and Pitcher barrels with Pitcher tubes. Field operations will further include CPT testing, piezometer and inclinometer installations, hydraulic pressure testing associated with rock core drilling, and observation well installation and development, which includes pump, permeability, and percolation testing. Contractors will be responsible for generating all associated documentation, to include detailed drill logs, trench or test-pit logs, as-built diagrams for all instrumentation and well installations, and percolation test records. Additionally, the contractor must occasionally furnish the professional services of a registered, licensed Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer. Furthermore, firms must possess the capability to provide certified geotechnical laboratory services. The required testing scope includes moisture content, soil classification, sieve analysis, hydrometer, Atterberg limits, consolidation, triaxial testing, direct shear, California Bearing Ratio (CBR), organic content, and Specific Gravity.
